gaps.reason: Iris, Frame and Plaza are priced from their SKUs (table 542), but the Lame documents give no vessel finishes; the palettes are the ones Mako prices (LAME-TOP-01).

A Solid Surface colour does not say whether it is Technolite, Technomood or Texturizzato (GEN-MAT-01). It is priced as SSTL, which costs the same per cm as SSTM and SSTEX, unless the basin decides the material.
Organizers are the Class ones (docx P0281) and are priced once per drawer that has a divider style; whether $170 / $150 is the price of one organizer is not confirmed.

Lame legs have no price yet: the price workbook spells them without a colour or width (VAN-LAMEV-LEG/2DW-12.4H, VAN-LAMEV-LEG/1DW-22.6H), gives no vessel heights and does not say whether one is ordered per cabinet; the cap (VAN-LAMEV-LEGCAP-, $0) has no colour suffix (LAME-ACC-01, LAME-ACC-02, LAME-ACC-03, LAME-ACC-05).
